Logo files

Every approved version, ready to use

Each version comes as SVG for web, PNG with a transparent background for documents and slides, and vector PDF for print. Built from Atlantium’s master Illustrator files.

Downloads work when this page is opened in claude.ai. Ask the brand team for the file pack if you see this note.

Master files Illustrator

The original artwork, including CMYK versions for print. The files are Illustrator documents saved with PDF compatibility; they open in Illustrator, Acrobat and any PDF viewer, and keep their original format in the ZIP.

Use RGB files (SVG, PNG) on screens and CMYK master files for print. PNGs are 3000 px wide (brandmark 2000 px). Keep the clear space shown in The logo section around every version.

Color palette

Aqua and navy lead, light blue and coral support

Aqua and navy are the primary colors. Light blue and coral are secondary: light blue for calm backgrounds and supporting graphics, coral for accents and calls to action. Select a color to copy its hex value.

For printed materials, produce a color print sample for the customer to approve before the run.

Extended digital palette Website 2026

The new website adds neutrals for text and backgrounds, plus soft pastels for content-type tags (always with navy text).

Icons

Line icons with a water line

Atlantium icons are single-weight outline drawings with rounded joins. Most carry a wave line inside, a quiet echo of the curve in the A.

Values 2023 guide

White line icons over water photography. See them in the Brand values section above.

Segments 2023 guide

Feature icons Master files

The full Atlantium icon library: one of each icon, redrawn to the same 48 px grid and the same 1.5 px line, with no labels. Select a style, then download single icons or the whole set.

One grid

Every icon sits in a 48 × 48 box, scaled so its longest side fills 40 px.

One line weight

1.5 px at 48 px with round caps and joins. Scale icons as a whole so the weight stays in proportion.

No labels

Icons carry no text. Set any caption in Poppins below the icon.

The guide draws segment icons in a bright cyan (#00D2D7). For new icons, use brand Aqua #34C0CC on light backgrounds and white on navy or imagery, at one stroke weight.

Tone & Voice Tone of Voice 2025

Friendly & professional

How we speak to partners, customers and every other audience. It keeps us on message, sets us apart from the competition and reflects who we are: our DNA, our team and how we communicate.

Our brand story

Water makes the world go around.
We make sure it’s treated right.

At Atlantium, we leverage our superior technology to tailor water treatment solutions that consistently perform to your changing needs.

PURE RESULTS
More treated water at higher ROI. Increase water production while significantly reducing your operational costs.
CLEAR CONFIDENCE
Water that’s always fit for purpose. Increase confidence by passing every test and consistently delivering the water quality you need.
FULL FLOW
Dependable and stable production, with minimal maintenance. Meets your expectations, by ensuring uncompromising, efficient performance and dependable production backed by expert service & support.

Our sloganATLANTIUM. PURE PERFORMANCE.

Our tone

While we strive to meet the highest professional standards, Atlantium’s DNA is one of “straight talk” and telling it like it is.

Professionals talking to professionals.

Our tone is friendly, without being overly “chummy”.

  • ×No fluff
  • ×No “marketingese”: boastful, over-used and highly subjective terms used to elevate a brand or product and coerce action
  • ×No false promises
  • ×No superlatives
  • ×No exclamation marks scattered through the copy. Emojis are for family & friends.

Points of style

Use contractions

Thanks, not thank you. You’re, not you are. It’s, not it is.

Speak directly to the audience

Where it makes sense: you can…, we’ve got… Use “we” when talking about Atlantium.

Keep sentences short

Short sentences are almost always preferable to long ones.

Anatomy of a post

  1. Open with the customer’s problem or the industry need, in plain terms.
  2. Bring in HOD™ (Hydro-Optic Disinfection) UV and what it achieved, with real numbers.
  3. Point to one action: download the brief, read the case study, “link in the bio”.
  4. Sign off with the brand line: Water makes the world go around. We make sure it’s treated right.
  5. Close with hashtags: #Atlantium #HODUV #uvtechnology #watertreatment #PurePerformance plus topic tags.
Technology postExplains the science behind a result, ending with why HOD UV.
Case study postProblem, solution and measurable outcome at a named site; thank the people involved.
Holiday postShort and warm; the A brandmark as the visual.

Every case study follows this structure, describes how the technology works, and ends with “About Atlantium”.

How the technology works

Atlantium HOD systems effectively inactivate pathogens and bacteria. This is achieved by combining ultraviolet water disinfection technology with hydraulic and optic principles. The HOD UV system features the unique Total Internal Reflection (TIR) technology that recycles UV light energy, ensures homogenous UV dose distribution, provides superior power (kW) efficiency compared to traditional UV, and achieves unprecedented micro-organism inactivation.

About Atlantium

For more than two decades, Atlantium Technologies has helped to ensure water safety with its innovative HOD™ (Hydro-Optic Disinfection) UV technology and novel approach to performance, monitoring, and control. Atlantium’s superior, environmentally friendly water treatment solutions ensure stable, efficient, and dependable production. With thousands of full-scale installations for leading brands in various industries globally, we’re committed to consistently meeting our customers’ water quality needs, ensuring pure results.

HOD UV systems Tone of Voice 2025

One technology, six product lines

HOD™ (Hydro-Optic Disinfection) UV is Atlantium’s unique philosophy and approach to advanced UV systems, which provides our customers with the best performance for their specific needs, minimizing use of chemicals and energy, and delivering pure results.

1Hydraulic
2Light
3Process know-how

The technology is designed to maximize efficacy and be simple to operate and maintain. Each HOD UV product line is optimized for specific needs and shares three key characteristics:

Optimized light and hydraulic structure

Ensures optimal flow of the water around the lamps, making sure there are no escape routes for organisms.

Dual sensor configuration

A sensor for lamp output and a UVT sensor ensure that only the minimum required dose is delivered.

AiO controller

Measures mission-critical parameters (flow rate, UVT, UV lamp output and actual UV dose) for real-time monitoring and control: the exact required dose, with the minimum required energy.

The product lines

We’ve developed several product lines to meet different water treatment needs. Our application team is here to help match the best system to each need.

RZ RZB RZM EP RS OC

HOD UV RZ & RZB Series

Total Internal Reflection (TIR) technology, for high UVT applications

Atlantium’s patented Total Internal Reflection (TIR) technology enhances UV disinfection by uniformly distributing light throughout the inactivation zone, effectively concentrating UV energy for optimal microorganism inactivation.

At the core of this system is its uniquely designed chamber, made of high-quality quartz surrounded by an air block instead of traditional stainless steel. The chamber traps Medium Pressure UV light photons, recycling their energy as they repeatedly bounce through the quartz surface back into the chamber. By eliminating escape routes and damaging microorganisms’ DNA, RNA and repair mechanisms, the system maximizes disinfection efficiency. Its design also helps reduce both CAPEX and OPEX.

Main market segments
Total Internal Reflection: UV light bounces through the quartz chamber instead of escaping.

HOD UV RZM Series

Designed for low UVT applications

A unique chamber lamp design, hydraulic structure and dual sensor configuration develop flow around the MP UV lamps. That eliminates escape routes and delivers the highest disinfection levels even at very low UVT, while ensuring pure results and maximum efficiency.

Also for other challenging water applications.

Main market segments

HOD UV EP Series

Designed for high flow rates

A unique chamber lamp design and hydraulic structure develop flow around the MP UV lamps, eliminating escape routes and delivering maximal disinfection levels even at very high flow rates, with minimal electrical power and head loss.

Main market segments

HOD UV RS Series

Designed for industrial applications with low to medium flow rates

The RS line is known for delivering pure performance with a small footprint, high efficiency, and ease of operation and maintenance.

Main market segments

HOD UV OC Series

Designed for optimal water treatment in open channels

An optimized flow adjustment structure with the most powerful LP high-intensity lamps eliminates organism escape routes, and the unique HOD UV sensor configuration optimizes system efficiency. The modular design fits different channels and flow rates and makes maintenance easy.

Main market segments
